name: CareOS — Hospital Pilot
subtitle: Clinical workflow assistant · synthetic adoption workspace
intended_use: Prepare evidence-linked summaries and follow-up tasks for clinical staff. No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing or treatment decision.
pilot_boundary: Synthetic data first; later bounded real-data pilot only after all blocking gates are approved.

gates.title: Intended use & non-goals
gates.question: Is the intended use narrow enough that everyone evaluates the same product?
gates.next: Keep this statement versioned; reopen this gate when clinical claims change.

gates.title: Privacy & data protection
gates.question: Are purpose, legal basis, minimisation, processor terms, retention and DPIA screening documented?
gates.next: Complete DPIA screening and verify processor terms for the selected deployment.

gates.title: Security architecture
gates.question: Are identity, authorisation, encryption, logging, incident handling and rollback understood?
gates.next: Run the threat-model review and demonstrate the kill switch.

gates.title: Clinical safety & quality
gates.question: Do the evals cover the failures that could matter in this workflow, and is escalation explicit?
gates.next: Agree the critical-error bar and run the labelled evaluation set.

gates.title: FHIR / ISiK / TI scope
gates.question: Does this exact deployment only consume existing interfaces, or does it trigger a product-specific confirmation / TI procedure?
gates.next: Classify CareOS' role in the target hospital architecture before assuming any specific approval body is required.

gates.title: Workforce & change
gates.question: Do affected staff understand what changes, what is measured, and what remains under human control?
gates.next: Run a 30-minute workflow review with actual end users before the pilot design freezes.

gates.title: Vendor, licence & procurement
gates.question: Are licences, vendors, commercial terms, processors and exit conditions reviewable in one place?
gates.next: Complete the reusable vendor pack; keep hospital-specific commercial decisions separate.

gates.title: Bounded pilot governance
gates.question: Are pilot boundaries, accountable humans, stop conditions, success metrics and rollback approved?
gates.next: This is the final gate: close the blocking reviews, then approve the bounded pilot as one explicit decision.

synthetic_benefits.label: Illustrative scenario — not measured impact

openaction.model: Early discovery + parallel review + reusable evidence

synthetic_benefits.assumption: Synthetic durations are simple example estimates assigned to the gates above. The OpenAction number uses the longest parallel review path plus final governance; it is not a forecast.

pilot_metrics: Days from first pilot conversation to approved bounded pilot
% of reviewer questions answered from the reusable Trust Passport
Number of blockers discovered after pilot design freeze
Number of gates reopened after a product change
End-user adoption and workflow outcome metrics
